limitations: Replays use actual accepted measurement USB emission streams and the actual observer's own report emission times; they do not reconstruct unseen radio arrivals or changed radio scheduling.

USB queue delay is removed from host time; rounding backsteps are clamped to preserve serial FIFO order. Capture startup cache is unknown; the first15s are excluded. Millisecond timing remains approximate.
Actual C++ Mesh(raw=false/filter=true) is compiled with ASan/UBSan. Public record() stays raw; C++ driver verifies identical receive acceptance and raw record contents.
Only actual USB observer solvers are scored. N3 scores use N3 USB captures; a replay at N1/N2 is not hardware N3 performance.
Local availability is the fraction of scheduled own reports with a located solution, not whole-network monitor/gossip availability.
Inconsistent or poor filtered geometry falls back only to a positioned latest-raw solution with its raw age/TTL. This avoids the demonstrated synthetic report loss; it is not an accuracy estimate.

Reported input age includes the oldest selected sample. Lower scatter does not establish accuracy; no thresholds are tuned to these captures. Host sizeof comparison is ABI-specific, not a measured target link-map footprint.
Known sleep-affected timestamp baseline is excluded. The approximate/movement-confounded latest placement is labeled and supports nominal error/jitter comparisons only.
